sources.title: SQLite CREATE VIEW
sources.finding: SQLite views are named SELECTs and are read-only unless an INSTEAD OF trigger is deliberately added.
sources.impact: A derived terminal projection can mechanically lack direct INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE authority.

sources.title: SQLite Foreign Key Support
sources.finding: Foreign keys enforce exists-relations but must be explicitly enabled per connection; composite keys and immediate/deferred constraints are supported.
sources.impact: Canonical support references are a strong conventional baseline, but FK configuration is itself an operational gate.

sources.title: DBSP: Automatic Incremental View Maintenance for Rich Query Languages
sources.finding: Derived views can be incrementally maintained across rich query languages.
sources.impact: CCW cannot claim novelty for efficiently maintaining derived state.

sources.title: Enzyme: Incremental View Maintenance for Data Engineering
sources.finding: Production-scale incremental materialized-view maintenance can choose refresh strategies automatically.
sources.impact: If CCW read amplification matters, non-authoritative materialization is conventional prior art rather than a new cognitive mechanism.

sources.title: Proof-Carrying Code
sources.finding: A consumer can validate a supplied proof against a fixed safety policy before accepting a result.
sources.impact: Proof-carrying completion is a close conceptual analogue; CCW cannot claim the general proof-witness idea as novel.

sources.title: Provenance Semirings
sources.finding: Query results can carry algebraic information describing why they follow from source data.
sources.impact: Why-provenance strongly collides with any broad claim that a derived terminal proposition plus support explanation is novel.

sources.title: W3C PROV Constraints
sources.finding: Valid provenance must form a consistent history; generation, usage and invalidation impose ordering/consistency constraints.
sources.impact: IDs merely existing is insufficient; coherent support history is an established provenance requirement.

sources.title: Linearly Refined Session Types
sources.finding: Session structure, refinements and linear logical resources can jointly enforce protocol/value constraints.
sources.impact: Typed protocol completion is established prior art; any ClayCode typestate variant must justify project-specific benefit.

destruction_result: Broad novelty claims fail. Derived views, provenance explanations, proof witnesses and typed protocol completion all have strong prior art. Only the Frank-specific semantic deletion claim remains researchable: whether DONE should cease to be canonical writable authority in this architecture.
